name: Dropbox

catalogGuideSteps.title: 계정 요금제 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: Dropbox 우측 상단 프로필 > [설정] > [요금제(Plan)]로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 요금제 취소 선택
catalogGuideSteps.description: 페이지 맨 아래로 스크롤하여 [요금제 취소]를 클릭합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 취소 사유 및 확정
catalogGuideSteps.description: 해지 사유를 선택하고 [취소 계속하기]를 눌러 완료합니다.

steps.label: Avatar (profile picture or initials) in bottom-left corner > Manage account

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide mentions top-right profile > [설정] > [요금제], while updated UI navigation has avatar in bottom-left corner > [Manage account] (which opens /account/plan) > [Cancel plan] at bottom of page. Step concepts match.
notes: Downgrades account to free Dropbox Basic at end of current billing cycle. Mobile app store purchases must be cancelled via App Store / Google Play.

name: Evernote

catalogGuideSteps.title: 계정 결제 정보 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: Evernote 웹 우측 상단 프로필 > [계정 정보] > [청구]로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 취소 링크
catalogGuideSteps.description: [구독 상태] 항목에서 [Evernote 구독 취소] 링크를 클릭합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: Free 플랜 다운그레이드
catalogGuideSteps.description: 무료 요금제(Evernote Free)로 다운그레이드함을 확인합니다.

steps.label: Cancel your Evernote subscription (at bottom of Billing page)
Provide a reason for canceling the subscription

retention.offers: Reverts account to Evernote Free with maximum 50 notes quota; retains existing notes/notebooks.

successText: Restore button in Billing History indicates successful cancellation
catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide mentions profile > [계정 정보] > [청구] > [Evernote 구독 취소] > Free 요금제 다운그레이드 확인. Official flow has an extra intermediate screen clicking [Continue to cancel] and survey step before [Cancel subscription]. Concepts match.
notes: Subscription remains active until end of billing cycle. In legacy billing system: Account Summary > Manage subscription > Evernote Free. Apple/Google Play subscriptions must be cancelled via their respective platforms.

name: Todoist

catalogGuideSteps.title: 설정 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: Todoist 우측 상단 아바타 아이콘 > [설정] > [구독] 탭으로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 관리 열기
catalogGuideSteps.description: [구독 관리] 버튼을 클릭하여 결제 포털로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 플랜 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: 결제 상세 화면에서 [플랜 취소]를 누르고 확인합니다.

steps.label: Choose a reason for the cancellation

retention.offers: Downgrades account to Beginner plan; retains existing tasks, but active personal projects drop to 5, filters to 3, and file uploads to 5 MB.

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide notes top-right avatar > [Settings] > [Subscription] > [구독 관리] (Manage subscription) > [플랜 취소]. In current direct web billing, users click avatar at top-left > Settings > Subscription > [Cancel plan] > Choose reason > [Cancel subscription]. Concepts match.
notes: Subscription tab is available on web and desktop apps, not mobile apps. If within 30-day refund window on yearly plan, users can choose immediate cancellation with refund or cancellation at end of period. App Store subscriptions must be canceled via Apple ID settings.

name: 1Password

catalogGuideSteps.title: 청구 페이지 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: 1Password 웹(my.1password.com) 로그인 후 우측 상단 계정명 > [청구]를 누릅니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 옵션 확인
catalogGuideSteps.description: 현재 이용 중인 개인 또는 가족 플랜 정보를 확인합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 구독 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: [구독 취소(Cancel Subscription)]를 클릭하고 확인 버튼을 누릅니다.

retention.offers: Account remains active until the end of current billing period, then account becomes frozen (read-only view/export, no editing or new items).

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide states: top-right account name > [청구] > [구독 취소(Cancel Subscription)]. In current web UI, [Billing] is located directly in the sidebar menu. The button is labelled [Cancel subscription]. Concepts match.
notes: Requires email, Master Password, and 1Password Secret Key to sign in. In family or team accounts, only family organizers or users with Manage Billing permission can cancel.

name: NordVPN

catalogGuideSteps.title: NordAccount 접속
catalogGuideSteps.description: NordAccount(my.nordaccount.com)에 로그인합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 청구 및 구독 확인
catalogGuideSteps.description: 좌측 메뉴 [Billing] > [Subscriptions] 탭으로 이동합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 자동 갱신 취소
catalogGuideSteps.description: [Auto-Renewal] 옆 [Manage] 클릭 후 [Cancel auto-renew]를 선택합니다.

catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide states: [Billing] > [Subscriptions] > [Auto-Renewal] 옆 [Manage] 클릭 후 [Cancel auto-renew] 선택. Current UI shows [Cancel] directly next to auto-renewal in Billing, followed by clicking [Cancel auto-renewal]. Concepts match.
notes: Cancelling auto-renewal stops subsequent billing while keeping service active until the end of the current term. Subscriptions made via App Store or Google Play must be canceled via their respective store settings.

name: Notion Plus

catalogGuideSteps.title: 워크스페이스 설정
catalogGuideSteps.description: Notion 좌측 상단 [설정(Settings)] 메뉴를 엽니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 요금제 탭 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: 워크스페이스 섹션의 [요금제(Billing & Plans)]를 클릭합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 무료로 다운그레이드
catalogGuideSteps.description: Plus 요금제 카드에서 [무료 플랜으로 다운그레이드]를 선택합니다.

retention.offers: Reverts workspace to Free Plan at the end of the current billing cycle; retains pages but team collaboration and premium Plus features are limited.

successText: You’ll receive confirmation of your downgrade, and see when your current plan ends
catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide states: [설정(Settings)] > [요금제(Billing & Plans)] > Plus 요금제 카드에서 [무료 플랜으로 다운그레이드]. Official doc shows: Settings > Billing > [Change plan] > Select the plan (Free) > [Continue] > Provide feedback > [Downgrade]. Overall concepts match.
notes: Subscriptions are billed per workspace. Downgrading to Free takes effect at the end of the billing cycle. Subscriptions purchased on mobile devices must be canceled via Apple App Store or Google Play.

name: Adobe Lightroom Mobile Premium

catalogGuideSteps.title: Adobe 플랜 이동
catalogGuideSteps.description: Adobe 계정 페이지(account.adobe.com/plans)에 로그인합니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: Lightroom 플랜 관리
catalogGuideSteps.description: Lightroom 프리미엄 플랜의 [플랜 관리] 버튼을 누릅니다.

catalogGuideSteps.title: 플랜 취소 완료
catalogGuideSteps.description: [플랜 취소]를 선택하여 해지합니다 (스토어 결제 시 구글플레이 구독 취소).

steps.label: Select the reason for cancellation > Continue

retention.offers: Shows plan details and alternative offers/plans before cancellation; access to paid apps continues until the end of current billing period.

successText: Check your email for a confirmation from Adobe or verify the cancellation on your account page
catalogDiscrepancy: Catalog guide lists [플랜 관리] > [플랜 취소] (with note regarding mobile store). Official Adobe flow for web-purchased plans has intermediate steps: [Manage plan] > [Cancel your plan] > [Continue to cancel] > Reason for cancellation > [Continue] > [Confirm cancellation]. For mobile in-app subscriptions, users must cancel via Google Play or Apple App Store. Concepts match.
notes: Direct Adobe web purchases cancel via account.adobe.com/plans. Subscriptions initiated on mobile via Apple App Store, Google Play, or Microsoft Store must be cancelled through that app store.
